figure_description:
A Cartesian coordinate plane with horizontal axis x and vertical axis y intersecting at origin O. Tick marks are shown every unit on both axes. The x-axis is labeled at 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, and the y-axis is labeled at 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12. A right triangle is plotted in the first quadrant with vertices at point P, point Q, and a third vertex at the right angle:
- Point P is at coordinates (8, 1).
- A horizontal leg extends from P(8, 1) to (12, 1), with length labeled 4 beneath it.
- A vertical leg extends from (12, 1) upward to point Q at (12, 12), with length labeled 11 to its right.
- The hypotenuse connects point P to point Q.
